wilyer-abreu.name: Wilyer Abreu
wilyer-abreu.top: Abreu is a fly-ball power hitter who wins with launch more than exit velocity. He lifts the ball far more than most hitters and turns an above-average share of it into barrels. His value comes from extra-base damage, supported by league-average plate discipline that has cut his strikeouts each season.

steven-kwan.name: Steven Kwan
steven-kwan.top: Kwan is an extreme contact-and-patience hitter who almost never misses, rarely chases and sprays consistent line drives to all fields without any exit velocity behind them. He drives value by getting on base through a high batting average and a rising walk rate, not by doing damage.
